concepts.short: The novel neural network architecture that replaces recurrent and convolutional layers entirely with attention mechanisms, enabling parallel processing and improved training efficiency.
An attention mechanism that computes a weighted sum over all positions in the same sequence, allowing each token to directly attend to every other token in the input.
A technique that runs multiple scaled dot-product attention functions in parallel, each with different learned projections, to capture information from different representation subspaces.
The core attention function that computes compatibility scores as dot products of queries and keys, scaled by 1/√dk to prevent vanishing gradients, then applies softmax to weight values.
Sinusoidal signals added to input embeddings to inject information about token order, since the Transformer has no inherent notion of sequence position.
The overall architecture with a stack of 6 identical encoder layers and 6 identical decoder layers, where the decoder additionally attends to encoder outputs via cross-attention.
Residual connections around each sub-layer followed by layer normalization, enabling training of deep networks by mitigating vanishing gradients and stabilizing activations.
A modification to self-attention in the decoder that prevents positions from attending to subsequent positions, preserving the auto-regressive property during generation.
